SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and speaking 15.1.1 Oral Reports- News (role play) together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy is enhanced as they watch and listen to audio visual recordings of News oral reports.

• Communication and collaboration is enhanced as they work in pairs and groups.

• Respect is enhanced as learners listen and critic others as the orally present reports

• Love is promoted as learners listen and record others speeches
